decisions.reason: The source permits horizontal orientation for the integrated single-board design; it does not change the separate modular power board's enclosure orientation or mechanical constraints.
The source concerns the integrated board and does not revise the modular main board's vertical rail mounting or connector-placement requirements.
The integrated board's orientation flexibility does not alter the separate sensor board's vertical mounting and connector-access constraints.
The source does not mention or necessarily change the battery connector's placement, orientation, clearance, or spacing.
Allowing either integrated-board orientation has no necessary effect on component sourceability, cost, or JLCPCB Basic-part selection.
Board orientation does not change the specified AXP2101 electrical topology, battery behavior, or charging requirements.
The source does not alter the ESP32 module, pin breakout, breakout pitch, or full-pin-access requirements.
The integrated board's physical orientation does not necessarily change I2C pull-ups, series resistors, bus speed, or cable assumptions.
The source addresses the integrated board's physical orientation, not the historical modular boards' interboard connector types, pinouts, or power topology.

The source confirms that the display can remain on the opposite face under a horizontal board orientation, but it does not change any current enclosure requirement such as the display cutout, hardware retention, or airflow.
The mechanical orientation choice has no necessary effect on ESP32-S3 GPIO availability or signal assignments.
The source does not change the required panel button, connector type, electrical connection, or power-control behavior.
